subject: S5 reinforcement movement after bomb detonation

source.ledger: docs/evidence/bootcamp-d11-footage-events.json event B2-012 (95.4-98.333 s); B1-050 objective completion at 86.8 s
source.finding: The reinforcement group stands on the pad from 95.4 s through the last pre-cut frame at 98.333 s, at least 11.533 s after objective 1995/1 completes. No walk-off is observed before the hard cut at 98.333 s.
source.primary_availability: The original video and cited frame mosaics are currently unavailable locally. The corrected frame ledger is a prior transcription of primary footage and cannot now be revalidated frame by frame in this workspace.

implementation_conflict.finding: Completing objective 1 triggers the three WalkTo actions immediately. Neither migration has a delay or a later event gate. The original branch contradicts the observed pad hold; the retry branch copied the unsupported timing without a direct original retry capture.

preserved: Van Valkenberg placement 198679 and the original objective transitions
correction.reasoning: Suppress only the immediate walk mechanic contradicted by direct footage. Stationary placement across the observed window is supported; behavior after 98.333 s remains unknown.
